annotations.title: Check a subnet before paying its fee

description: Call this before paying the registration fee of a Bittensor subnet. It returns, in plain sentences measured from the chain, what the fee is now, how many of the entries made 2 to 14 days ago are still in and what a typical one is paid a day today, how many days today's fee takes to come back at that pay, how the entries from two to four weeks ago ended up, who is paid today, and what the measurement cannot see.
name: check_contest
title: Check a subnet before paying its fee
